unit.why: This is a short quoted saying from Imrei Kadosh (the Strelisk rebbe): R. Michel had a special soul and therefore could not bear anyone who blemished the covenant. Nothing happens to anyone, so there is no narrative.
unit.boundary_note: The previous division is a homiletic quotation on shame and repentance. The next division begins a separate Besht–R. Michel story quoted from Tiferet Shlomo; it is thematically linked but is not a continuation of this division.
